name: Van Hanh
role: Buddhist patriarch, trusted counselor of Lê Đại Hành and teacher of Lý Công Uẩn; popularly credited with shaping the smooth 1009 succession
known_facts: Trusted advisor (cố vấn tin cẩn) of vua Lê Đại Hành
Regarded as the spiritual leader of the people in the early Buddhist age
The transmission of omens and sấm truyền around Lý Công Uẩn's rise is traditionally linked to his circle
interpretation: Early-Lý era Vietnamese Buddhist monk dress (plain saffron-brown robe, conical or monks' hat), based on the user reference.
unknowns: No verified contemporary life portrait survives
